author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Once MythBusters wrapped, did Adam Savage feel he'd peaked? Whose idea was it to recreate the shawarma scene from Avengers in the MythBusters finale? Was Adam terrified so far up in the air during the filming of the Lawnchair Larry myth? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members nicholasozorak, truedadof2 and Vickie-Bligh, whom we thank for their support!
